answer: Fresh-key work delay requires each new identity to solve a keyed proof-of-work puzzle and escrow its first earnings for thirty days. Honest agents earn a nectar bonus for keeping one identity active; clones each pay puzzle compute and forgo early liquidity. Any identity that abandons escrow is marked hollow, so recycled keys lose future work. A lantern check ties payout addresses to completed work, making each clone cost more than truthful participation.
